# Corpus census

<!-- Generated by `tests/live_outs.rs`. Do not edit by hand: refresh it with
     `UPDATE_CORPUS_CENSUS=1 cargo test --test live_outs`. -->

What the corpus under `examples/`, `tests/golden/` and `tests/compat/` is made
of, measured rather than remembered.

It is the denominator of sub-plan G's live-out measurement (`postmortem.md`
§G.22), and it moves whenever a fixture is added — so **nothing else quotes
it**. `doc/design.md` §8, `doc/k65-compat-manifest.md` and the rest cite this file,
and `the_census_is_published_in_one_place` fails if one of them starts restating
a count instead.

Counted from the AST of every unit that compiles, by a walk that matches
exhaustively: a construct that grows a block later stops the file from compiling
rather than going uncounted.

## Unit compilations

| | count |
|---|---|
| unit compilations | 172 |
| of those, compiling | 128 |
| refusing on purpose | 44 |

A *unit compilation* is one file of one fixture, compiled with the siblings its
fixture names. A refusal is a fixture that pins one, and every one of them says
why — either in its own `fixture.txt` or in `REFUSALS`.

## Sections and call sites

| | count |
|---|---|
| emitted sections | 303 |
| of those, declaring an output | 5 |
| `inline` sections (no exit to seed) | 13 |
| of those, declaring an output | 7 |
| call sites: `call foo` (the escape hatch) | 37 |
| call sites: stating a flow (`add a, x -> a, y`) | 3 |
| call sites: a bare name | 6 |
| call sites: a hand-written `jsr`/`jsl` | 15 |
| `inline` uses (expansions, not calls) | 24 |

**The second row is the one the argument rests on.** Most of the corpus
declares no output at all — an `inline` is not one of them, having no exit to
seed — so most of it cannot be narrowed by any rule. That is why narrowing the
live-out seed would buy three instructions and six bytes and not more, and why
sub-plan F's decision 12 is a deferral with a price rather than an oversight.

The measurement itself is not here. It is `tests/live_outs.rs`'s `DIFFERENCE`
table, and it is a *conclusion* rather than a count: it did not move when the
numbers above did. A denominator growing is a new fixture; the measurement
growing is a finding.
